en.title: Minimum Replacements to Remove Adjacent Equal Characters in Each Word
en.description:
For each lowercase English word, you may replace any character with any lowercase letter; find the minimum number of replacements needed so that all adjacent characters differ. Output the result for each word independently.

The ranges added by this site for missing bounds and the recovery of source typos are described in the input protocol.
en.input: The input gives the number of words n and n lines of words. The full original bounds are kept: 1≤n≤100, each word has length 2..100000, and the characters are a..z; no total-length constraint is added to shrink the input, so the total number of characters can reach 10000000.
en.output: Output the minimum number of replacements for each word in input order, separated by spaces or newlines.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 1 1 0; 0 1 1 0 1; 1 3. They have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Split each word into runs of identical consecutive characters; a run of length L contributes floor(L/2).
